clauses.clause: Underground readability: player contrast ≥ 3:1; infected eyes brightest pixels.
clauses.note: Fresh pooled L6 emergency/headlamp tunnel fixture at x110/z15, actual infected62, both render tiers. Opened all14 original1280x720 native/background/ID/body/eye/repeat frames: heroine has a clear bright gold silhouette; infected has separate red eye islands under a warm forehead. Courier/background contrast is21.7842/21.5157 with .02 offset (11.3803/11.2545 with .05), all≥3:1. Linear-sRGB eye maxima low0.24487004/high0.23464440 exceed non-eye body maximum0.23217151. Exact native-repeat body pixels match after mask restoration. Repro: SCENE_PORT=4834 BROWSER_POOL_JOB_ID=rr-b node --import tsx/esm tools/qa/sweep-b-l6-readability.ts low tunnel 62 (repeat high); python3 test-results/rr-b/l6-analyze.py.
